storylines: CASEY: Closing takes. I'll be honest — a shutout loss to the same team twice in one season, with an ejection in the third, that's a tough note to end a game on. But twenty shots, a strong third period defensively, Hepner standing tall — the pieces are there. This group just needs to put it together for a full sixty. GORD: This is the last game of the season. So there's no next week to fix it. You sit with a zero on the scoreboard, a player ejected, and two losses to the same team all summer. That's what the off-season is for — remembering what this felt like and deciding you don't want to feel it again. CASEY: Thanks for listening to Ice and Easy, the Village People Hockey Podcast. It's been a season. GORD: Learn to finish. Both the game and your checks — but we can't do that here, so at least finish the game.
